MUSIC AND DANCE — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   B. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.

3. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

5. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   C. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

6. Best practice when working on Instrumental Transpositions: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Instrumental Transpositions.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Instrumental Transpositions.
   C. Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Instrumental Transpositions.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   C. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

8. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Instruments.
   B. Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Instruments.

9. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.
   C. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.

10. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.
   D. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   D. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

15. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   B. Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Instrumental Transpositions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Four-Part Harmony and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Songs from Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
